title: gen-vis definition
description: A chart of gen-vis 4, see https://github.com/petres/gen-vis. A definition can be a part which is merged into its parent, so no entry is required.

$schema.description: The version of the definition language, the schema of gen-vis 4 (https://unpkg.com/@preschen/gen-vis@4/schema.json, also of jsdelivr, a full version, e.g. @4.1.0, or node_modules/@preschen/gen-vis/schema.json of the installed package), a definition file needs it, in itself or in a parent.

parent.description: Url of the definition this one is deep merged into, relative to this definition, or a list of them (mixins) merged in their order, later ones override earlier ones. Arrays are replaced, not merged.

data.description: Url of the data, relative to the definition, CSV, TSV, JSON or parquet, by the extension or dataFormat.

dataFormat.description: The format of the data, by default the one of the extension of its url, without one parquet, CSV or JSON by the content.

geo.description: The geometry of a map (coord geo), the rows are joined to its features, null removes the one of a parent.

annotations.description: An annotation or a list of them, bands, lines, texts and circles at values of the mappings, e.g. { "type": "band", "x": ["2025-07-01", null], "label": "Schätzung" }.

transform.description: Columns computed of the data, e.g. an index of a base year, in their order, see https://github.com/petres/gen-vis/blob/main/docs/definition.md#transform.

filter.description: The rows of the conditions of mappings, null removes the ones of a parent.

globals.description: Values changed by the form elements, e.g. the shared scales of the facets.

mapping.description: Maps columns of the data to named dimensions, the plots and all other parts of the definition refer to these names, a text is the column, null removes a mapping, e.g. of a parent.

plot.description: A plot or a list of plots, drawn in order.

geo.description: The geometry of a map (coord geo), the rows are joined to its features.

data.description: Url of GeoJSON or TopoJSON, relative to the definition, or the GeoJSON or TopoJSON itself.

object.description: The object of TopoJSON, the first one by default.

key.description: The key of the features, id (default) or a property, e.g. NUTS_ID.

name.description: The property of the names of the features, name by default.

join.description: The mapping whose values are the keys of the features.

include.description: Only the features of these keys, e.g. the countries of the EU.

exclude.description: The features of these keys are not drawn at all, e.g. ["RU", "BY"].

projection.description: A d3 projection (type, mercator by default) and its parameters, e.g. rotate, center or parallels.

fit.description: The features the projection is fitted to, all (default), the ones with data or a list of keys.

filter.description: The rows of the conditions of mappings: a value or a list of values, e.g. a global of a form element { "year": "@year" }, null (no value), { "not": ... } or { "range": [from, to] } (null is open).

none.description: Removes the part of a parent.

removed.description: null or false removes the part, e.g. the one of a parent.

key.description: A key of a feature of a map or of a category, compared as a string.

label.description: A label of a band or a line, a template of the globals.

text.description: The text of a text, a template of the globals.

above.description: Above the plots, below them by default, as layer above.

layer.description: Below the plots and the axes (default) or above all plots.

legend.description: The name of the annotation in the legend (a template of the globals), with a symbol of it: a vertical line of a line at a value of x, a horizontal one of y, a box of a band, a dot of a circle; one entry per name, after the legends of the mappings.

before.description: Right before the plot of this id, in its layer, e.g. lines above the bars but below the labels whose halo cuts them.

facet.description: The facets of the annotation, a key or a list of them, all by default; of a grid also the values of the mappings of its rows and columns, e.g. { "group": "Bau" } (a column, a row or a cell).

additionalProperties.description: A value or a range [from, to] of the mapping, a reference to a global, e.g. "@target", or a computed prop, null is no value, of a range the edge of the domain.

domainValue.description: A value of a mapping, e.g. a date of a string, a reference "@name", e.g. to a global, or a computed prop, null is taken from the data.

value.description: A value, a reference "@name" or an expression of an operator.

number.description: A number, a reference "@name", e.g. to a global, or an expression, e.g. of totalWidth.

props.description: Svg attributes (and text), values, references "@name", expressions of operators or nested props, e.g. d of a path.

anyOf.description: Nested props, e.g. d of a path, an object which is no operator.

locale.description: Number and date formats, the name of a built-in locale, a language of Intl (e.g. fr or de-CH) or a d3 locale definition merged into one.

base.description: de, en or a language of Intl.

texts.description: The titles of the buttons and the texts of screen readers.

copy.description: The button of the copy of the PNG.

copied.description: The title of the copy after a copy.

chart.description: The kind of a facet with a hover, e.g. chart.

keys.description: The description of the keys of the hover.

number.description: See d3.formatLocale, e.g. decimal, thousands, grouping and currency ([prefix, suffix]).

time.description: See d3.timeFormatLocale, e.g. date, months and shortMonths.

timeTicks.description: The formats of the ticks of time axes without format, by the interval of the date.

footer.description: HTML, e.g. a link of the source, a template of the globals, their values are text.

message.description: A text instead of the plots and the legends, a template and a prop of the globals and totalWidth, e.g. steps of a narrow screen, null or an empty text for the plots.

empty.description: A text instead of the plots if there are no rows, e.g. of a filter, a template of the globals.

class.description: The class of the element of the visualisation (vis), a template of the globals, e.g. for the styles of a page.

transition.description: The elements move to their new values in this many milliseconds (true for 300) after a change of a legend, a form element or the state.

highlight.description: The highlight of the elements, see highlight and others of the plots.

transition.description: The attributes move to the ones of the highlight in this many milliseconds, e.g. 50.

hover.description: The content of the hover without the hover slot, templates of html, their values are text.

total.description: A row of the sum of the stacked values of the position below the rows (true, or its name, e.g. Gesamt), in the format of the values; also {total} of the title.

mode.description: The rows of the nearest position of the axis (position, by default) or the row of the nearest point, e.g. of a scatter plot.

radius.description: The distance of the nearest point in pixels, 30 by default.

filter.description: The rows with a hover, e.g. not the ones of headers.

box.description: false: no box of the hover, its highlight and the events stay, e.g. a hover of the highlight only.

marker.description: false: no line of the position of the hover.

empty.description: true: a hover also without rows, e.g. the name of a region without a value.

position.description: The hover is beside the marker of the position (or the center of a region) or at the pointer.

side.description: The side of the hover, by default the one with more space, center on the position, e.g. in the center of a polar plot.

offset.description: Moves the hover by [x, y] pixels.

area.description: The area of the hover, the plot area or the facet with its margins, e.g. the labels of the rows of horizontal bars.

title.description: The title, {title} is the default one, e.g. the date, and the globals.

row.description: A row instead of the table: {land} the name of a category, {land.unit} another hover prop, {y} the formatted value, {y.value} the value, and the globals.

width.description: The width of the container if not given.

height.description: The height of a facet in pixels, 400 by default.

anyOf.description: A registered coordinate system, see registerCoord.

coord.description: The coordinate system of the plots, cartesian (a horizontal and a vertical axis) by default, polar (an angle and a radius) or geo (a map).

fontFamily.description: Css font-family, by default the css variable --gen-vis-font-family or Century Gothic.

of.description: The scale of another mapping, e.g. "y", the values of this one are positions on it too, e.g. the other end of a band, and they are in its domain, without the other parts of a scale.

type.description: By default linear for a numeric mapping, time for a date one, band (bars) or point for a categorical position and ordinal for other categorical ones. A d3 scale, continuous scales and the ones of classes (quantize, quantile, threshold) need a numeric or date mapping, point and band a categorical one, ordinal ones are of any values, e.g. colors of categories, positions of dates need a time or utc scale.

orientation.description: null: no position, e.g. a y mapping of the sizes of points. Places the scale on the plot, horizontal and vertical in the cartesian coordinate system, angular and radial in the polar one.

domain.description: Fixes the domain, a null first or last entry is taken from the data, the values are converted as the ones of the data, e.g. dates, and can be references, e.g. to a global. A diverging scale has a middle entry, a threshold scale the values between its classes, a point or band scale its categories in their order.

include.description: Values the domain taken from the data includes, e.g. 0 or 100, a value or a list, also references.

center.description: The domain taken from the data is symmetric around this value, e.g. 0 of changes.

closed.description: The end of the classes of a threshold scale they include, the lower one (left, value >= limit) or the upper one (right, value > limit).

domainRel.description: Extends the domain relative to its size.

domainAbs.description: Extends the domain by absolute values.

pad.description: Extends the domain relative to its size at both ends (a number) or at the start and the end ([start, end]), positive values extend, e.g. 0.1 of 10% below and above; instead of domainRel, whose values are added (a positive start shrinks).

domainIgnores.description: The conditions of the filter of the definition (their mappings, true all) the domain taken from the data ignores, e.g. ["month"] of a slider over months: the scale is the same for all months, the plots draw the rows of the month.

nice.description: Numeric mappings only: rounds the ends of the domain taken from the data, e.g. 0.951 to 1, true for steps of about a tenth of the domain or the number of steps.

range.description: By default the width or height of the plot, e.g. colors, references to the sizes of the coordinate system, e.g. "@radius".

padding.description: Band and point scales: the space between the categories and at the ends in steps, 0.4 by default; of a point scale of angles the place of the first category in steps, half a step after the top (0.5) by default, 0 at the top, e.g. of a radar chart.

step.description: The pixels of a category of a vertical band or point scale, the height of the plot is the one of its categories (instead of options.height), e.g. the rows of horizontal bars keep their size if some are hidden.

order.description: The order of the categories of the data of a band, point or ordinal scale: of the rows (default), ascending, descending or by the value of a mapping of their first row, e.g. bars by their length.

groups.description: The categories of a band or point scale in groups of the values of a mapping of their rows, with a space between the groups.

by.description: The mapping of the groups, e.g. a column of the group of a row.

padding.description: The space between the groups in steps of the categories, 1 by default.

inset.description: The space at the start and the end of the range in pixels (of positions), a number for both or [start, end], e.g. so the first and the last point are not at the edges of the plot area.

interpolator.description: The colors of a sequential or diverging scale, a d3 interpolator, e.g. Blues, Viridis or RdYlGn.

scheme.description: The colors of the range, a d3 scheme, e.g. Blues or Tableau10.

classes.description: The number of colors of a scheme of several sizes, by default the number of classes of a threshold scale or 5.

position.description: top, bottom, left or right of the cartesian coordinate system, angular (around the circle) or radial (from the center) of the polar one.

at.description: Cartesian axes: the line of the axis at this value of the mapping of the other axis, e.g. 0 of an axis of x at y = 0 or a date of an axis of y, converted as the values of the data, also a reference "@zero"; a value outside of the domain of the other scale leaves it at its edge (`position`, also the side of its labels and tick marks).

angle.description: The angle of a radial axis in degrees, clockwise from the top, 0 by default.

gridShape.description: The grid lines of a radial axis, circles or polygons through the ticks of the angle, e.g. of radar charts.

ticks.description: The number of the ticks, null for the ones of tickSpacing, e.g. of a parent.

tickSpacing.description: Without ticks, a tick per this many pixels of the length of the axis, e.g. 80.

values.description: Fixed ticks, converted as the values of the data, categories as strings, e.g. [2004, 2008] or ["2004", "2008"] of the years of any format of the data, the ones outside of the domain or which are no category of a band or point scale are left out, also a prop, e.g. steps of totalWidth.

format.description: A d3 number or time format.

labels.description: The props of the labels of the ticks (svg attributes and text), of the props of the categories of the tick and of the categories of its row of the mappings `by`, its values and the names of the facet, e.g. { "by": ["level"], "props": { "font-weight": "@weight", "text": "@short", "max-width": 300 } }, of all axes, e.g. { "props": { "fill": "#777", "font-size": 10, "stroke-width": 2 } } of the values of a radial axis in the background, the stroke and its width replace the halo of the labels of radial axes.

by.description: The mappings of categories whose props the labels have, of the categories of the row of the tick, a mapping or a list of them, as `by` of a plot.

at.description: Of an axis at a value (`at`): the labels at the edge of the plot area (edge, by default), only the line and the tick marks at the value, or with them (axis), without the label where the other axis crosses.

curved.description: Angular axes: the labels along the circle, centered at the tick (true) or between it and the next one (between), e.g. the names of the months, the ones of the lower half are not upside down.

tickMarks.description: The tick marks: false leaves them out (the labels stay at their places), their length (size, 9 pixels across the line of cartesian axes, 6 outside of the circle of angular ones by default, the labels move with it), the part of it inside the plot area (inset, by default 4 pixels of bottom and right axes, 5 of top and left ones, 0 of angular ones, e.g. 0 for marks outside only) and their props (svg attributes of the names of the facet), e.g. { "props": { "stroke": "var(--gen-vis-grid-color)" } }, radial axes have none.

domain.description: The props of the line of the axis (svg attributes, its class is domain, a circle of an angular axis) of the names of the facet, e.g. { "props": { "stroke-opacity": 0.4 } }.

rotate.description: The angle of the labels in degrees, positive counterclockwise, negative clockwise.

offset.description: The distance from the axis in pixels, by default of cartesian axes 8 pixels inside the edge of the margin, of radial axes 16 pixels outside of the circle (see the prop defaults).

position.description: Of a vertical axis: beside it, rotated, in the middle of the range of its scale (side), or horizontal above its range (top), e.g. the unit at the top left, starting at the distance offset from the axis.

gap.description: Of a title at the top: its distance above the range of the scale, 8 pixels by default.

padding.description: The gap between the tick marks and the labels in pixels, also of polar axes, 3 by default (see the prop defaults).

column.description: The column of the data, can be a template of globals, e.g. "{values}{share}", see formElements.

type.description: Without a type it follows from the other parts (categories or a band, point or ordinal scale are categorical, a time or utc scale date, other scales numeric, a mapping of the facets or of the groups of a scale categorical, not one only used as `by` of a plot) or from the values of the column: numbers numeric, dates date, otherwise categorical (a column without values, e.g. of empty data, date of a time format of the mapping, its axis or its hover, otherwise categorical). Missing and invalid numeric and date values are null, dates are timestamps or strings, a date without a time zone, e.g. 2024-06-01 or 01.06.2024 13:00, is the one of the time zone of the scale, local or UTC (utc). Categorical values are strings of every format of the data, e.g. "2004" of the number 2004 of JSON or parquet.

format.description: The d3 format of the values (a time format of dates), the one of the axis and of the hover without their own, e.g. ",.0f".

stacked.description: Stacks the values of the axis of the values, a vertical, a horizontal (of horizontal bars), a radial or an angular one (of pies, polar:arc from @<name>:start:scaled to @<name>:end:scaled), true all rows or the conditions of mappings of the rows which are stacked, as the ones of filter, e.g. { "type": { "not": "load" } }, the others have their own value as start and end, e.g. a line of a total on stacked areas.

interval.description: Of a date mapping: a value is the period starting at it, day, week, month, quarter, half (a year), year or a number of them, e.g. "6 months": the domain of the data reaches the end of the last period, bars are in the middle of their period (80% of its length by default), @x:scaled:center and @x:scaled:end are its middle and its end, @x:step its length, the hover shows the period, e.g. H2 2023 (%K is the half of the year in formats).

stackBy.description: Of a stacked mapping: the mapping of the positions of the stacks, by default the one of the positions of the coordinate system (x of vertical bars), e.g. the start of the class of a bin (lo) of a histogram whose x are the values of the rows; rows without a value of it are not stacked.

cell.description: false: the value is a name of the templates of the hover (e.g. {half} of the title), without a cell of the table.

format.description: By default the format of the axis.

props.description: The columns of the entries of a categorical mapping, name by default.

row.description: The rows of the hover of the categories of a categorical mapping.

props.description: CSS properties of the row of a category, props of the props of the categories, e.g. { "font-style": "@hoverStyle" }, the nearest row stays bold.

anyOf.description: Toggles of the categories of the props, without props the colors of the scale.

position.description: The place of the legend, above or below the plots or beside them, the plots have the rest of the width, a prop of totalWidth (the width of the visualisation), e.g. below the plots of a phone.

orientation.description: The direction of the scale of the colors, a vertical one has the high values at the top, a prop of totalWidth (the width of the visualisation).

onlyData.description: Only the entries of the categories of the rows after the filter, e.g. of the selected year, also the hidden ones.

size.description: The length of the scale of the colors in pixels.

values.description: The ticks of a gradient of colors, e.g. [0, 50, 100].

labels.description: The labels of the scale of colors after it (below, right of a vertical one) or before it.

format.description: The format of the values of the colors of a scale, by default the one of the hover.

missing.description: An entry of the regions without a value beside the colors of a scale, e.g. { "name": "no data", "color": "#EEE" }.

domain.description: The domain of the scale, see scale.domain, e.g. [0, null].

nice.description: Rounds the ends of the domain of the scale, see scale.nice.

categories.description: The categories by their key (the value of the column) and their props, e.g. colors, in the order of the legend, the facets and the stacks, only visible ones are shown.

scheme.description: The colors of the categories in their order as the prop color, a d3 scheme, e.g. Tableau10.

fromData.description: The values of the column which are not in categories are categories as well, after them, in ascending order.

order.description: The order of the categories: the one of categories (keys which are integers ascending first), ascending, descending (numbers by their value) or a list of keys which are first.

ranks.description: The props of the categories by their rank in the order: of the first one, the second one, ..., the last entry is the one of all others, e.g. the newest year red.

mapping.description: A mapping of a column, x and y (polar also angle and radius) have a scale of their orientation and an axis, false removes them.

type.description: year: the year of a date, align: the date in the year `year`, index: relative to the mean of the base, mean: the mean of the base (all rows by default) of the group, share: of the sum of the group, rolling: the mean of `size` rows, cumulative: the sum up to the row, calc: the value of the expression `expr` of the row, filter: only the rows whose expression `expr` is true, rank: the rank in the group, random: a random number of the row in `range`, the same of every draw (`seed`), lookup: the `value` of the row of a file of `data` of the `key`, bin: a row per class of `edges` and group of `by` with its `start`, `end` and the number of the values of `column` in it (`as`), after the rows or instead of them (`replace`).

column.description: The column of the values, a template of the globals, of a lookup the one of the keys.

expr.description: calc: the expression of the value of the row, filter: the expression of the rows which are kept, its names are the columns of the row and the globals, e.g. { "*": [{ "/": ["@value", "@inno"] }, 100] } or { ">": ["@value", 0] }.

min.description: mean: the least number of values, without as many values the mean is missing, 1 by default.

descending.description: rank: the largest value is the first one.

data.description: lookup: the url of a file of rows, relative to the definition, not a template.

dataFormat.description: lookup: the format of the file, by default the one of the extension of its url.

key.description: lookup: the column of the keys of the rows of the file; random: the column of the keys of the rows, e.g. an id, a row keeps its number also if the rows of the file are in another order (by default its index in the data).

value.description: lookup: the column of the values of the rows of the file, a template of the globals, e.g. "name_{lang}".

as.description: The name of the new column, by default the one of `column`, which it replaces; bin: the column of the number of the values of the class, count by default.

edges.description: bin: the edges of the classes, numbers and ranges { "from": 50, "to": 250, "step": 5 }, sorted together, e.g. [{ "from": 50, "to": 250, "step": 5 }, 143]. A class includes its start, the last one also its end, values outside the edges are left out.

step.description: bin: the width of the classes without edges, also a template of the globals, e.g. "{step}", from the multiple of it below the least value to the one above the largest one.

weight.description: bin: the column of the weights of the rows, the value of a class is the sum of the weights of its values, e.g. of a reporting lag.

normalize.description: bin: the value of a class, the count (or the sum of the weights), the share of the sum of the group or the density (the share per unit of column, per `per` units), e.g. densities of categories of different sizes.

per.description: bin: the value per this many units of the width of a class, e.g. 5 of the count per 5k of classes of unequal widths, of a density the share per 5 units.

start.description: bin: the column of the start of the class, start by default.

end.description: bin: the column of the end of the class, end by default.

replace.description: bin: the rows of the classes replace the rows; by default they come after them, e.g. a histogram and a strip plot of the same values, the plots draw the rows with the values they use.

range.description: random: the least and the largest number, [0, 1] by default.

seed.description: random: another seed gives other numbers, 0 by default.

by.description: The groups of the rows of the same values of these columns, e.g. a line per category.

order.description: The column of the order of the rows of rolling and cumulative, e.g. the date, the order of the rows by default.

base.description: The rows of the base of an index or of a mean: a column and its value, e.g. { "year": "{base}" }, or a range [from, to], e.g. of dates or years, { "year": [1961, 1990] }.

scale.description: The value of the base of an index (100 by default).

size.description: The number of the rows of the window of rolling.

align.description: The window of rolling: the rows before the row (end, by default) or around it.

year.description: The year of align, 2020 by default.

legendSymbol.description: The symbol before the name of a category: line, rect or circle in its color, auto of the plots of the categories (a box of their bars or areas, a line of their lines, a dot of their points), or the svg elements, drawn in a box of width x height pixels (size both, by default the one of the defaults of the chart, 16) from 0, 0, at the middle of the capitals of the name.

width.description: The width of the box, size by default, e.g. a longer line of a dash.

height.description: The height of the box, size by default.

elements.description: Left out, the type replaces them, e.g. the ones of a parent.

type.description: An svg element, e.g. line or circle.

legend.description: false: the category has no entry in the legend, it stays visible, e.g. headers.

symbol.description: The symbol of the entry of the category in the legend instead of the one of the legend, e.g. a rect of an area beside lines.

anyOf.description: A type of the coordinate system of the definition (line is cartesian:line or polar:line), of svg elements (circle is svg:circle of cartesian plots, point is circle) with the default props of the type, a definition writes only the props which differ.
A registered plot type, see registerPlotType.
A registered plot type of the coordinate system without its prefix, see registerPlotType.

type.description: The full name of a type has the default props of the type, as its name without the prefix. The svg types draw an svg element per row in any coordinate system, the others are the ones of their coordinate system, the lines and areas a path per group, geo:base all features, geo:mesh the borders of an object of TopoJSON as one path, the others an element per row. The annotation types draw an annotation per row, e.g. of events, see annotations.

id.description: The class and the data-plot of the group of the plot, plot-<index> by default, the plots of a parent are merged by their ids.

by.description: The rows are grouped by this mapping or these mappings, e.g. a line per category, the props of their categories are available in the props.

data.description: Rows of the plot instead of the ones of the data, e.g. events, with the names of the mappings and others, e.g. a label, or the url of a file of them. The values of rows of the definition are props, e.g. references to globals.

dataFormat.description: The format of the url of the data, by default the one of its extension.

filter.description: The rows of the plot, of the conditions of mappings, see filter of the definition.

place.description: geo:text: a label at the pole of inaccessibility of the largest polygon of its feature, the point farthest from its edges (default), or at its centroid.

fit.description: geo:text: only the labels which fit into the area around their place (estimated of their characters and font size).

overlap.description: geo:text: false leaves out the labels which overlap the one of a larger area, so a map needs no list of the labels shown.

once.description: One element per facet, of no row: its props are the names of the facet, e.g. a header or a unit label at the edge of the plot area, "y": "@plot:top", "text": "@facet:name".

select.description: One row of every group: the first or the last one, or the one with the least or the most value of a mapping, e.g. labels at the ends of lines.

object.description: geo:mesh: the object of the TopoJSON of the borders, the one of the geometry by default, e.g. the states above the districts.

borders.description: geo:mesh: all borders, the ones between two features (inner) or the outline (outer).

dodge.description: svg:text: the texts are moved apart vertically to at least this distance, e.g. labels at the ends of lines; polar:text: the texts of the same angle along the radius.

halo.description: svg:text, polar:text: a halo behind the texts in the color of --gen-vis-halo-color, true (3 pixels) or its width, the props of the plot replace its stroke props.

layer.description: below: below the axes and grid lines, above: above the other plots, between them by default.

facet.description: The facets of the plot, a key or a list of them, all by default; of a grid also the values of the mappings of its rows and columns, e.g. { "group": "Bau" } (a column, a row or a cell).

highlight.description: The props of the elements of the category of the hover or of the entry of the legend, e.g. { "stroke-width": 3 }, mode: the elements of the category (group, default) or only the one of its row (row), e.g. a segment of a stacked bar.

curve.description: The interpolation of the paths and areas between their points, monotoneX is smooth without overshooting the values, the closed ones connect the last point with the first one, e.g. of radar charts.

others.description: The props of the other elements of the plot while an element is highlighted, e.g. { "opacity": 0.3 }.

dim.description: A plot for every category of this mapping, in cols columns.

cols.description: The number of the columns of the facets of dim, 1 by default; or the mapping of the columns of a grid, its categories are the columns (their names the headers above them).

rows.description: The mapping of the rows of a grid of facets, its categories are the rows (their names the headers beside them), with cols a mapping or alone (one column).

rowHeaders.description: The headers of the rows of a grid: right of them rotated (default) or left of them horizontal, in a column of the width of the longest one.

axisTitles.description: The titles of the axes in every facet (all) or only at the outer ones (outer): of the bottom axis in the bottom row, of the left one in the first column, of the right one in the last column, of the top one in the first row.

props.description: CSS properties of the titles, e.g. { "font-weight": "normal", "text-align": "center" }, of the props of the category of the facet (e.g. @color), @facet:name and the globals.

scales.description: The mappings which share their scale across all facets, or a reference to a global; of a grid also an object of the mappings and all, row (a scale per row, e.g. y) or col (per column, e.g. x), the labels of such a scale only at the outer facets.

formElement.description: Entries of a parent are patched by their id, so only the id is required.

type.description: Radio buttons, a drop down list, a slider over the entries or hidden, the global is set by the page (the prop globals).

inImage.description: The selection is named below the subtitle of the PNG, false for ones which only change the presentation, e.g. shared scales.

oneOf.description: The distinct values of a column of the data, ascending.

items.description: An entry, other fields of scalars are names of the templates while it is selected, e.g. {group:short} of a field short of the entry of the global group.

globals.description: Globals which are set when the entry is selected, e.g. a name used by the texts.

patch.description: Patches the definition while the entry is selected, merged in the order of the form elements, null removes a part.

expression.description: An operator, an object of one key, the operator, and its arguments, e.g. { "*": ["@innerWidth", 0.5] } or { "steps": ["@totalWidth", { "0": 220, "550": 250 }] }, see spec/expressions.md of the package.

-.description: The first value minus the others, of one value its negation.

/.description: The first value divided by the others, no value of a division by 0.

round.description: [value, digits]: the value rounded to digits (0 by default), halves up.

==.description: The same values, as texts, e.g. 2024 and "2024".

<.description: Numbers by their value, otherwise texts, false of a missing value, more values are a chain, e.g. [0, "@x", 10].

not.description: True of a false value (false, 0, "", null, an empty list).

if.description: [condition, value, condition, value, ..., otherwise]: the value of the first true condition.

and.description: The first false value, otherwise the last one.

or.description: The first true value, otherwise the last one, e.g. a default ["@color", "black"].

steps.description: [value, { "cut": value, ... }]: the value of the largest cut below the value, e.g. ["@totalWidth", { "0": 220, "550": 250 }].

match.description: [value, { "case": value, ... }, default]: the value of the case of the value (as a text), otherwise the default.

format.description: [value, format]: the value as a text of a d3 format in the locale, e.g. ["@y", ",.1f"] or of dates ["@x", "%b %Y"].

literal.description: A value which is not evaluated, e.g. a text starting with @.

var.description: A reference, a name or [name, default], the default of an unknown name.

args.description: The arguments of an operator, a list of expressions or a single one.
